FN-DR57TTH-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 337
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/24/2024
Senate Bill 337 as introduced would appropriate a total of $30 million from the Opioid
Treatment and Abatement Fund for fiscal year 2024 to the following entities in the following
amounts:
 Department of Corrections: $1 million;
 Board of Pardons and Paroles: $5,490,000;
 Department of Mental Health: $20,510,000;
 Auburn University: $1 million;
 University of Alabama at Birmingham: $1 million; and
 Department of Public Health: $1 million.
This bill would also provide that these funds shall not revert at the end of fiscal year 2024 but
shall be carried forward for the purposes appropriated.
